# Drawing text-box page fields

Original OOXML controls generated by `tools/shape_page_fields_fixture.py`, using
the project's original drawing constructor and dense-guides package. No corpus
artwork is redistributed. The reference application exported the references
without saving changes to the sources. `record_shape_page_fields.py` records
source/PDF hashes, displayed strings and PDF font sizes independently of the app.

The default, `--header`, and `--plain` fixtures each have three pages and eight
controls per page. The first section starts at lower-Roman iii and occupies two
pages; the second starts at decimal 8. Cached results deliberately contain 99.
The controls cover simple/complex PAGE, NUMPAGES, SECTIONPAGES, lock flags,
caps/small caps and the optional MERGEFORMAT switch.

The reference application preserves body result formatting with MERGEFORMAT. Without it, unlocked
body fields use instruction-run formatting; simple fields use paragraph defaults.
The plain complex NUMPAGES instruction deliberately uses Arial 14pt while its
cached result uses Arial 20pt. The reference application renders it at 14.04pt. Locked results retain
their cached text and 20pt formatting. Body PAGE caps are uppercase; small caps
are approximately 16pt for the 20pt source. Repeated header PAGE values ignore
capitalization and retain the full size. Header PAGE/NUMPAGES refresh even when
locked, while locked SECTIONPAGES stays 99.

Browser checks compare actual drawing paint strings and sizes, then insert a
page break, verify changing counts and section numbering, export and reopen.
Body edits preserve other package parts and undo restores all original parts.
Repeated-header documents remain read-only and download unchanged. Unit tests
also reject malformed, nested and unsupported field instructions.

These fixtures establish the supported nonnested page-field subset, not general
field evaluation, drawing-text editing, or arbitrary rich-text field results.
